sources.entry: Readflow - Lightweight news reader with modern interface and features: full-text search, automatic categorization, archiving, offline support, notifications. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Go/Docker

summary.one_liner: Readflow is a self-hostable personal news reader that collects Internet articles into one place, with categories, offline saving, and webhook integrations.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a feed-style reader where you read articles from many sources in one interface. Articles can be saved for offline reading or exported to disk in formats such as HTML, PDF, EPUB, or ZIP. Users can create categories and classify new articles, and a scripting engine lets them customize article handling. Incoming and outgoing webhooks link it to external services, including newsletters, RSS, Keeper, Pocket, Shaarli, Wallabag, and S3 buckets. It also sends notifications when new articles arrive and offers a Progressive Web App interface. A companion command-line client, readflow-ctl, manages articles, categories, and webhooks through the GraphQL API and includes an MCP server for AI assistants.
use_cases: Read news and articles from many sites in one place
Save articles for offline reading or export as PDF or EPUB
Sort incoming articles into categories automatically
Forward articles to Pocket, Wallabag, Shaarli, or S3
Give AI assistants read-only access to saved articles
how_to_run: curl -sf | sh  (pre-compiled binary; URL missing from README)
readflow init-config -f config.toml  (then set READFLOW_CONFIG or use -c)
notable: Webhook integrations with Pocket, Wallabag, Shaarli, RSS, and S3 buckets
Scripting engine for customizing article processing
readflow-ctl CLI with an MCP server exposing read-only data to AI tools
Saves articles in multiple formats such as PDF, EPUB, and ZIP
Advertised as free of ads and trackers
caveats: The README does not state platform requirements beyond Go and Docker options
